scope: 7 major out-of-sample evaluations across the research lab (dynamic-inplay WDL, player-state, xG-fusion, event-process, residual goal-intensity, near-term scoring horizon, discipline)
method: An evaluation is classified by whether SIX traceability dimensions are independently reconstructible from local artifacts ONLY (no network/provider): (1) dataset manifest with counts; (2) the exact match cohort (ids); (3) the split protocol (forward-chain order / LOCO / fold defs); (4) a frozen reference model; (5) the reported metric file; (6) the stated bootstrap UNIT (match vs row). reproducible_verified = all six present AND at least one headline metric independently RECOMPUTED bit-close to reported. reproducible_with_limitations = manifests+cohort+metric present and recomputable in principle, but a parametric/fitted model or a row-level (non-clustered) bootstrap unit limits an exact cold rerun. needs_rerun = artifacts present but a metric was NOT recomputed here and a defect/ambiguity blocks confidence. cannot_reproduce = a required dimension (cohort ids / reference / metric) is absent.
bootstrap_unit_policy: The statistically-honest independent unit is the MATCH, not the snapshot row. Evaluations that pool RPS/Brier over snapshot rows (many rows per match) overstate effective N; their pooled point estimate is reproducible but significance must use a match-level cluster bootstrap. This is recorded per evaluation.

evaluations.name: Residual goal-intensity W/D/L (R0-R6)
evaluations.reference_model: research.residual.w2_reference_r0 (parameter-free W2 remaining-time Poisson -> exact convolution)
split_protocols: forward_chain (4 folds, ordered by first kickoff)
evaluations.recompute_independence: R0 reimplemented from scratch from raw snapshot CSV columns (no residual_intensity import); per-fold RPS, pooled RPS, and the 58-value LOCO per-match RPS array all reproduce to 5 decimals (abs_diff 0.0).
evaluations.bootstrap_unit_used_in_run: row-pooled for the point estimate; rg_wdl_loco_bootstrap.json carries match-level CIs
evaluations.limitations: R0 is verified bit-exact; the fitted candidates (r1/r3/r4/r5) are reproducible_with_limitations individually (require sklearn ridge/HGB + isotonic fit); none beats R0 so the scientific conclusion does not depend on them.

evaluations.name: Near-term scoring horizon (H0-H4, next 5/10/15m)
evaluations.cohort: same 58-match cohort; 22128 horizon test rows (7376 x 3 horizons)
evaluations.recompute_independence: h0 is parameter-free and recomputable by the same engine; not recomputed in THIS pass (out of the residual-WDL primary scope). Right-censoring at 5/10/15m (4.7%/10.5%/17.0%) is documented in rg_dataset_manifest.json and must be handled identically on rerun.
evaluations.limitations: Metric not independently recomputed here; censoring handling is a reproducibility-sensitive choice. Conclusion (no candidate beats h0) is consistent with the residual-WDL finding.

evaluations.name: Remaining-goal intensity (I0-I3, Poisson deviance)
evaluations.recompute_independence: i0 is parameter-free; recomputable but not recomputed in this pass. i1/i2 require fitted ridge/regime heads.
evaluations.limitations: Fitted candidates limit an exact cold rerun; i0 reference is verifiable. No candidate beats i0.

evaluations.name: Event-process intelligence (e0-e9 WDL, q/h/y heads)
evaluations.reference_model: e2 remaining-time Poisson reference (same 1.35/90 base rate as residual W2)
evaluations.cohort: shares the 258-exact-bridge intl population; effective fit/test population is the same 58 event-bearing matches (cohort identical to residual phase)
evaluations.recompute_independence: Snapshot builder + e2 reference are deterministic and local; the 58-match event-bearing limitation is the SAME root cause audited here. Leakage self-test (50 sampled rows) all_ok in build_manifest.json.
evaluations.limitations: Same 58-match data-availability ceiling; fitted e-heads need sklearn. Reference path verifiable.

evaluations.name: Dynamic in-play W/D/L (M0-M5 / p4/p5 player-state)
evaluations.cohort: API-Football reconciled in-play snapshots (corpus 900 + ext); regulation-only, exact-reconciliation gate
evaluations.recompute_independence: Dataset manifest (model_decision_ledger.json: dataset_version dynamic_state_v1, source_manifest_version api_football_result_v1) + reference + metric present. Snapshots rebuild from the gitignored API-Football corpus; reference r2 is parameter-free. Not recomputed in this pass.
evaluations.limitations: Cohort match-ids not re-enumerated in this audit; requires the corpus to rebuild snapshots. Fitted player-state heads (p4/p5) need refit. p5 rejected on a safety rule, so conclusion stands regardless.

evaluations.name: Player-state + xG-fusion WDL/next-goal
evaluations.cohort: StatsBomb-bridged matches with xG; xg_snapshot_join_audit.json reports 4386 xG-eligible international snapshots across 258 distinct bridge matches (xG-bearing subset), 4323 nonzero-xG rows
evaluations.headline_metric_reported: see data/reference/event_process / residual ledgers; xG models gated to nonzero-xG subset
evaluations.recompute_independence: xG causal self-tests all pass (dynamic_xg_state_audit.json: no-future-xg, monotonic cum-xg, regulation-only, no cross-match leakage). The xG-fusion EVAL inherits the same 58 event-bearing matches for snapshot-level fusion; the 258 figure in the join audit counts bridge matches at the xG-field level, not event-bearing snapshot matches.
evaluations.limitations: xG models are fitted; the join-audit 258 vs snapshot 58 distinction (see residual audit) must be carried forward to avoid overstating xG eval N.

evaluations.name: Discipline / sendings-off (red-card threshold) eval
evaluations.cohort: red-threshold extension manifest; canonical_counts_ledger reports 960 reconciled fixtures, 128 canonical sendings-off (union across resolved roots); note flags scope ambiguity (123=900-corpus, 176=1120 incl ext)
evaluations.headline_metric_reported: not consolidated into a single decision-ledger metric file in this workspace
evaluations.recompute_independence: The canonical_counts_ledger explicitly records a SCOPE ambiguity in the sendings-off total (123 vs 128 vs 176 depending on resolved roots). Without a single frozen cohort+metric file the discipline eval cannot be reproduced cold with confidence.
evaluations.limitations: Missing a frozen decision-ledger + enumerated cohort for the discipline eval; sendings-off count is root-dependent. Recommend freezing one cohort (declare resolved roots) and one metric file before any claim.

summary.cross_cutting_finding: Five of the seven evaluations (all event-bearing StatsBomb evals: residual WDL/intensity/horizon, event-process, xG-fusion) share ONE binding data-availability ceiling: only 58 of the 258 exact-bridge international matches have StatsBomb event JSONs cached on disk. statsbomb_cache_audit.json overstates this as 258 valid_cached; the snapshot builder and on-disk file count both confirm 58. The bootstrap UNIT across all of them must be the MATCH (58 clusters), not the snapshot row, when computing significance.
